output.reason: The linked PR [ev-28662c9c9ed6] says the change is "Bump haproxy to 3.0.8 as in the chart's version by default". Its changed files [ev-ac61ded0e395] are only the HA redis-ha chart values and the HA install manifests (install.yaml, namespace-install.yaml and the hydrator variants). That gives the subject (the haproxy image version in the HA manifests), the change (an update to 3.0.8) and who is exposed (installs that use the HA manifests). For the consequence, the issue the PR "helps with" [ev-36d2a844f18c][ev-068177aa33ae] reports that argocd-redis-ha-haproxy pods fail to start in HA deployments; a separate commit addresses the automount part of that issue [ev-62113a7c59e0]. The previous haproxy version is not stated and the PR only says it "helps with" the failure, so confidence is low.
